profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer (Front End) at USAA
profile.summary: A highly responsible, organized, and bilingual full-stack Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience developing and securing software and website performances. Manage technology projects from concept to completion with remarkable deadline sensitivity. Solved and prevented software and system failures for reputable organizations by ensuring that the developed product meets the desired goals and adheres to the company’s usability standards. A strong team player through complete project cycles: development, testing, and implementation. Ethical, loyal, and maintains a high degree of confidentiality.
